# All wards statistics

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every ward's beds in use, stay so far and discharges held up.

## What is on the screen

1. Wards at a glance. Wards at or over the alert line, wards with none ready, ready beds and pulled beds not yet arrived.
2. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly. Each opens its own page.
3. Compare wards. Opens Compare, with every ward side by side.
4. By service or one list. Group the wards by health service, or show them as one list.
5. Highlight wards. Marks the wards with a pulled bed, a discharge held up or the other states. Press again to clear.
6. Every ward. Beds in use, occupied and ready for each ward. Open a ward for its own figures.
7. Stay so far. Average days so far for people in a bed now, for the wards with the longest.
8. Discharges held up. Discharges with something in the way, counted by ward.

## On a phone

- Amber dot. Says what an amber dot on a ward means.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
